preprocessing.normalization: divide entire supplied mono16k crop by its peak + 1e-8
preprocessing.padding: repeat short waveform and trim to 5 seconds
preprocessing.crop: center 5 seconds if supplied input is longer
preprocessing.score_direction: native label1=real; fake score=1-sigmoid(native real logit)
preprocessing.threshold: author inference.py fixed fake score >=0.5; no threshold tuning

policy.status: engineering abstention policy; not calibrated on a validation set

selection: First four distinct genuine contexts ordered by SHA256('20261023:partial:'+humanID+':'+syntheticID); >=12s context, >=4s synthetic source, same-speaker/source_utt pair; genuine alternate source chosen by SHA256('20261023:partial:control:'+ID)

construction.context_and_excerpt_policy: Center by sample count after existing mono16 conversion; no repetition, padding, gain normalization or crossfade
construction.position: Centered in 12-second context, identical boundaries for partial and genuine splice control
construction.candidate_aggregation: Equal mean of anchored native-size windows

assessment.aggregation: Arithmetic mean of complete native-size anchored window scores
assessment.interpretation: Uncalibrated model score, not a probability that the recording is AI. Applies to speech; speech presence and language are not independently verified.

diagnostics.activity_definition: 20 ms frame RMS > -50 dBFS; energy activity, not speech detection

source_measurements.representation: decoded source channels; no mixing, resampling or normalization
limitations: Measures decoded samples; decoder precision and lossy-codec history remain relevant.
Sample peak is not oversampled true peak; near-full-scale samples do not prove clipping.
Null dB values indicate zero energy or an undefined ratio, not missing samples.
Mixdown attenuation describes channel interaction, not tampering or synthetic speech.

analysis_representation.resampling: scipy.signal.resample_poly; reduced rational factors; default Kaiser filter
analysis_representation.scope: Top-level RMS, peak, DC, crest, spectral and activity metrics use this derived signal; source clipping, channel RMS and stereo correlation use decoded original channels.

scope: Small constructed challenge on spent English v4 sources. Known synthetic insert presence is the reference, not a claim about natural mixed-audio detection or edit localization.
